JOYSTAR Miss Cruiser Girls' Beach Cruiser Bike - 12" to 16"
Bring the classic boardwalk charm to your neighborhood with the JOYSTAR Miss Cruiser. Designed specifically for girls aged 2-7, this beach cruiser blends vintage style with modern safety, helping young riders cruise with confidence and grace.

Breezy beach style meets sidewalk safety: The JOYSTAR Miss Cruiser.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Inspired by classic beach cruisers, the Miss Cruiser features a step-through frame and intuitive braking for the ultimate relaxing ride."
Built for Young Riders
The Miss Cruiser is built with a sturdy HI-TEN steel frame and fork, providing excellent impact resistance for rocky or bumpy paths. To ensure safety for beginners, it features an intuitive rear coaster brake—simply pedal backward to stop—allowing children to stay in full control at all times.

Safe, simple, and stylish: Engineered for little hands and big dreams.

Key Features & Benefits

Classic Cruiser Design: Elegant step-through frame with stylish fenders and painted rims.

Maximum Comfort: Equipped with a dual-spring cruiser seat and soft grips for a smooth, upright riding position.

Growth-Adjustable: Both the saddle and stem are height-adjustable to provide a better fit as she grows.

Safety First: Includes a fully enclosed chain guard to protect little legs and heavy-duty training wheels for stability.

Quick & Easy Assembly
We make it easy to start the adventure. The Miss Cruiser arrives 85% pre-assembled. All you need to do is install the front wheel, handlebar, saddle, and pedals using the included tools.

Assembly Guide: Get your Miss Cruiser ready for the road in minutes.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Watch the Miss Cruiser in action: Effortless pedaling and neighborhood fun.

Included Extras: Front & Rear Fenders, Training Wheels, DIY Decals, and Bike Bell

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR stands by every bike we build, offering peace of mind for every parent:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: Your steel frame and fork are covered for as long as you own the bike.

Authentic Support: 100% authentic JOYSTAR parts and dedicated customer service for all your riding needs.
